summary: Frontend-only test of the new 'Films & anime' recommendation card (testID='sd-media-card') on the Self-Defense discipline detail screen. Tested boxing, kendo, and bjj end-to-end with TEST_FE_ITER11_TOKEN (ui_test_user_1). ALL checks pass: (1) Card renders BETWEEN sd-patron-card and sd-progress-card and BEFORE the 'Next session' header on every discipline (vertical positions verified — patron < media < progress < 'Next session' header in DOM/layout); (2) Initially collapsed: count badge + sd-media-summary visible ('7 recommendations · 4 with Catholic themes' for boxing, '8 rec · 1 catholic' for kendo, '6 rec · 2 catholic' for bjj); zero sd-media-item-* nodes rendered in collapsed state; (3) Tapping sd-media-toggle expands cleanly — boxing renders 7 items, kendo 8 items, bjj 6 items, each with kind badge (FILM/ANIME/SERIES/DOCUMENTARY), title, year, origin where present, and 'why' description; (4) CATHOLIC badge (sd-media-catholic-{n}) renders on the expected Catholic-flagged works — boxing 4× (Rocky, On the Waterfront, Cinderella Man, Raging Bull), kendo 1× (Silence), bjj 2× (Warrior, Like Water); (5) All expected titles found verbatim in the rendered DOM for each discipline; (6) Footnote 'Watch with discernment — not every work is suitable for every viewer…' (sd-media-footnote) renders at the bottom of the expanded list; (7) Second tap on sd-media-toggle collapses cleanly — items return to 0, summary reappears, footnote disappears. No errors, no red screen, no missing assets. Data file /app/frontend/src/utils/martial-arts-media.ts contents match request spec exactly.
critical_code_review_comments: Component is clean and well-scoped (~250 lines, single responsibility). All interactive elements have testID. Uses Pressable + accessibilityLabel; touch target (full-width header) is comfortably >44pt.

Pre-existing repo-wide warning still present (not introduced by this iteration): '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — same as iter11/iter12, no functional impact and unrelated to the new media card.

Minor cosmetic suggestion (non-blocking, do not act unless desired): in collapsed state, the count badge in the header is visually redundant with the 'N recommendations' sub-summary line — both show the count. Acceptable as-is; mentioning only because it caught the eye during review.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every checkpoint passes for all 3 sampled disciplines (boxing, kendo, bjj); data file confirms muay_thai, goju_ryu, wrestling lists also conform to spec

seed_data_creation: Re-ran /app/backend/tests/setup_iter11_auth.py to refresh the ui_test_user_1 / TEST_FE_ITER11_TOKEN session (7-day expiry). No new data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Films & anime card feature is fully working on boxing / kendo / bjj. The remaining three disciplines (muay_thai, goju_ryu, wrestling) were not exercised in the browser but their data is verified in /app/frontend/src/utils/martial-arts-media.ts and uses the exact same component path (MartialArtsMediaList renders by disciplineId off MARTIAL_ARTS_MEDIA). If any future regression report comes in for those, repeat the same flow: localStorage.setItem('sanctus_session_token', JSON.stringify('TEST_FE_ITER11_TOKEN')), navigate to /self-defense/{discipline}, tap [data-testid="sd-media-toggle"], assert sd-media-item-* count matches MARTIAL_ARTS_MEDIA[discipline].length.
